title: Compiled requirement introspection
summary: A compiled template can report unique variable paths and formatter names in first-use order. TemplateRequirements returns detached copies of those inventories without resolving context data, invoking object getters or running formatter code.
uses: preflight whether required data is available
inspect report/message/prompt requirements without flattening object data
invariants: Requirement inspection is observation, not execution.
Unformatted substitutions explicitly require the identity formatter.
Requirement arrays returned to callers are detached copies.
